questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “He could not ____ the loss of his friend.”
questions.why: 'Get over' means recover from. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

opts: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
No sooner the bell had rung than the students rushed out.
No sooner did the bell rang than the students rushed out.
No sooner had the bell rung when the students rushed out.
questions.why: 'No sooner' takes inversion (had + subject + past participle) and pairs with 'than'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Select the correct meaning of the proverb: A stitch in time saves nine
opts: nine stitches will save the damage
timely stitches will save the patient
timely action will prevent further loss
He is taller than me am.
He is taller than I am.
He is taller than I am tall.
questions.why: 'Than I am': subject pronoun with the verb. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.
